subject: ela
skillName: Identify main topic and key details
intro: The main topic of an informational text is what the whole text is mostly about. A multiparagraph text has one main topic, but each paragraph has its own focus — a specific part of that big topic. To find the main topic, ask: 'What is every paragraph talking about?' To find a paragraph's focus, ask: 'What is this paragraph mostly about?'

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: Frogs are amphibians that live both in water and on land. They have smooth, moist skin and strong back legs for jumping.

Paragraph 2: Baby frogs, called tadpoles, look very different from adult frogs. Tadpoles hatch from eggs and live only in water. They have tails for swimming. Slowly, they grow legs, lose their tails, and become frogs.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?

steps: I ask: what are both paragraphs talking about? Both are about frogs.
The main topic is frogs.
Now I look at paragraph 2 only. What is it mostly about?
Paragraph 2 describes tadpoles — how they hatch, live in water, and change into frogs.
The focus of paragraph 2 is how tadpoles change into frogs.
solution.answer: The main topic is frogs. The focus of paragraph 2 is how baby frogs (tadpoles) grow and change into adult frogs.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: The ocean is full of amazing creatures. Fish, dolphins, sharks, and sea turtles all swim in ocean waters. Tiny plants called phytoplankton float near the surface.

Paragraph 2: The deepest part of the ocean is the Mariana Trench. It is nearly seven miles deep. The water there is pitch black and freezing cold. Strange creatures like anglerfish and giant squid live in this dark zone.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?

steps: I ask: what are both paragraphs about? Both are about the ocean.
The main topic is the ocean and its creatures.
Now I look at paragraph 2. What is it mostly about?
It describes the Mariana Trench — the deepest, darkest part of the ocean and the animals there.
The focus of paragraph 2 is the deep ocean and the creatures that live there.
solution.answer: The main topic is the ocean and its amazing creatures. The focus of paragraph 2 is the deepest part of the ocean, the Mariana Trench, and the creatures that live there.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: Bears are large, powerful mammals found on several continents. They have thick fur, strong claws, and excellent senses of smell.

Paragraph 2: In autumn, bears eat as much food as possible. They need to store fat because in winter they sleep for months in a den. This long winter sleep is called hibernation. During hibernation, bears live off their stored fat.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?

steps: Both paragraphs are about bears. The main topic is bears.
Now I look at paragraph 2 only.
It talks about what bears do in autumn and winter — eating a lot, sleeping in a den, and hibernating.
The focus of paragraph 2 is how bears prepare for and survive winter through hibernation.
solution.answer: The main topic is bears. The focus of paragraph 2 is how bears prepare for winter and hibernate in their dens.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: Community helpers are people who work to make our neighborhoods safe and healthy. Police officers, firefighters, and doctors are all community helpers.

Paragraph 2: Teachers are also important community helpers. They help children learn to read, write, and solve problems. Teachers prepare students for the future. Without teachers, it would be very hard for children to get an education.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?

steps: Both paragraphs are about community helpers. That is the main topic.
Paragraph 2 focuses on one specific type of community helper: teachers.
It explains what teachers do and why they are important.
The focus of paragraph 2 is the role of teachers as community helpers.
solution.answer: The main topic is community helpers. The focus of paragraph 2 is teachers and the important work they do to help children learn.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: Water exists in three forms — liquid, solid, and gas. Rain and rivers are liquid water. Ice and snow are solid water. Steam is water in gas form.

Paragraph 2: Clouds form when liquid water evaporates and rises into the air as a gas called water vapor. High in the sky, the water vapor cools and turns back into tiny liquid droplets that form clouds. Eventually, the droplets join together and fall back to Earth as rain or snow.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?

steps: Both paragraphs are about water. The main topic is water and its different forms.
Paragraph 2 focuses specifically on how water moves from the ground to the sky and back.
This is the water cycle — evaporation, cloud formation, and rain.
The focus of paragraph 2 is how clouds form and how water returns to Earth as rain or snow.
solution.answer: The main topic is water and its different forms. The focus of paragraph 2 is how clouds form and how water returns to Earth as rain or snow.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: Insects are the most common type of animal on Earth. They have six legs, three body sections, and most have wings.

Paragraph 2: Butterflies are insects that go through a four-stage life cycle called metamorphosis. They start as eggs, then become caterpillars, then form a chrysalis. Inside the chrysalis, the caterpillar transforms into a butterfly.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?
items.hint: Ask yourself: What are both paragraphs about? Then ask: What is paragraph 2 only about?

steps: Both paragraphs are about insects. The main topic is insects.
Paragraph 2 focuses on one insect — the butterfly — and describes its life cycle.
The focus of paragraph 2 is the four-stage life cycle of butterflies.
solution.answer: The main topic is insects. The focus of paragraph 2 is the four-stage life cycle of the butterfly, called metamorphosis.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: Deserts are dry places that get very little rainfall each year. They can be extremely hot during the day and cold at night.

Paragraph 2: Despite the harsh conditions, many animals make their homes in deserts. Lizards, snakes, and scorpions live there. Roadrunners and owls also thrive in desert habitats. These animals have special features that help them survive with little water.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?
items.hint: What is the same topic in both paragraphs? What new thing does paragraph 2 add?

steps: Both paragraphs are about deserts. The main topic is deserts.
Paragraph 2 focuses on the animals that live in deserts and how they survive.
The focus of paragraph 2 is the animals that live in desert habitats.
solution.answer: The main topic is deserts. The focus of paragraph 2 is the animals that live in deserts and their ability to survive harsh conditions.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: The American Revolution was a war in which American colonists fought for their freedom from British rule. The war lasted from 1775 to 1783.

Paragraph 2: George Washington led the American army during the Revolution. He kept his soldiers together through cold winters and difficult battles. His leadership helped the colonists win their independence. Washington later became the first President of the United States.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?
items.hint: Paragraph 2 focuses on one important person. Who is it, and what did he do?

steps: Both paragraphs are about the American Revolution. The main topic is the American Revolution.
Paragraph 2 focuses on George Washington's role as a leader in the Revolution.
The focus of paragraph 2 is George Washington's leadership during the American Revolution.
solution.answer: The main topic is the American Revolution. The focus of paragraph 2 is George Washington's leadership and how he helped the colonists win independence.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: The sun is a star at the center of our solar system. It is so large that about one million Earths could fit inside it.

Paragraph 2: The sun provides the energy that makes life on Earth possible. Plants use sunlight to make food. That food feeds animals, including humans. The sun also warms our planet so water can stay liquid and weather can occur.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?
items.hint: What are both paragraphs about? What does paragraph 2 explain that paragraph 1 does not?

steps: Both paragraphs are about the sun. The main topic is the sun.
Paragraph 2 explains why the sun is important — how it supports life on Earth.
The focus of paragraph 2 is how the sun's energy supports life on Earth.
solution.answer: The main topic is the sun. The focus of paragraph 2 is how the sun's energy makes life on Earth possible.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Paragraph 1: Mountains are large landforms that rise high above the surrounding land. They are found on every continent.

Paragraph 2: Many animals live in mountain habitats. Mountain goats can climb steep, rocky slopes. Snow leopards hunt smaller animals in the high peaks. Eagles nest on cliff ledges and soar above the valleys looking for prey.

What is the main topic of this article? What is the focus of paragraph 2?
items.hint: Ask what both paragraphs have in common. Then ask what specific idea paragraph 2 adds.

steps: Both paragraphs are about mountains. The main topic is mountains.
Paragraph 2 focuses on the animals that live in mountain habitats.
The focus of paragraph 2 is the animals of mountain habitats.
solution.answer: The main topic is mountains. The focus of paragraph 2 is the animals that live in mountain habitats.
